name: Online Compass
description: A free online compass that reads your device magnetometer and shows the direction you are facing — degrees plus the N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW label — right in the browser.
longDescription: Online Compass turns the phone or laptop you are already holding into a working magnetic compass. Allow motion sensors, lay the device flat, and the dial follows the direction you face while a large readout shows the angle in degrees and the matching cardinal point. Readings are smoothed so the needle settles instead of jumping, and the whole dial can go fullscreen for a bigger, easier read. Nothing is uploaded and nothing needs an account: the sensor stream is read on the device and the page works offline once it has loaded.
pricingDetails: Free — no sign-up, no usage limit, no paid tier. Sensor readings never leave the device.
features: Live dial driven by the device magnetometer, rotating with the direction you face
Degree readout with the matching cardinal point (N 0°, NE 45°, E 90° …)
Smoothed needle movement so the reading settles instead of flickering
Fullscreen mode for a large, arm's-length reading
Works offline once the page has loaded — no network needed for the sensor
No install, no account; sensor data stays on the device
useCases: Finding which way is north when setting up furniture or a treadmill
Checking the orientation of a room, a tent or a parked car
Reading a rough bearing while walking without a hardware compass
Teaching cardinal and intercardinal directions with a live dial
